description: Delayed memory retrieval scenarios (session A writes, session B recalls).

session_a_neurons.title: JWT expiry policy
session_a_neurons.content: Access tokens expire in 15 minutes and refresh tokens rotate every 7 days.

session_a_neurons.title: PreCompact WAL checkpoint
session_a_neurons.content: Run PRAGMA wal_checkpoint FULL before handover to prevent stale pages.

session_a_neurons.title: Graphify import mode
session_a_neurons.content: Graph import runs with code_only true and keeps non-code neurons intact.

session_a_neurons.title: pytest temp brain fixture
session_a_neurons.content: Use tmp_path/.brain/brain.db with migrate() in setup for isolated tests.

session_a_neurons.title: SessionStart injection frozen snapshot
session_a_neurons.content: SessionStart injection uses a frozen snapshot and does not mutate when remember runs mid-session.
